title: ADR Index
description: Every architecture decision candidate the pipeline's steps raised, with the task that raised it and whether it became a numbered record. Lives beside the records it indexes, in .nit/adr/.

id.description: Derived from the task that raised it and a slug of its title, so rebuilding the index keeps the same id for the same candidate.

context.description: The problem that forced the decision, carried verbatim from the candidate.

status.description: The candidate's own status as the step reported it.

raisedBy.description: Where the candidate came from, so a reader can go back to the work that prompted it.

promotedTo.description: Path of the numbered ADR this became. Absent while the candidate is still outstanding — which is what makes 'outstanding' a computable question rather than a judgement.
